Patient enquiries for a private clinic

A sample project showing how we would build a steady flow of appointment enquiries for a local healthcare provider.

Project

Patient enquiries for a private clinic

Industry

Healthcare

Challenge

A private clinic relies on referrals and walk-ins. Its website is slow, hard to use on a phone, and does not appear when people search for treatments nearby. Enquiries that do arrive by phone and WhatsApp are not tracked.

Strategy

Make the clinic easy to find and easy to contact. Combine local search work with focused search campaigns, give every treatment a clear page, and introduce a response process so every enquiry is logged and followed up. All advertising and content follow applicable healthcare advertising rules, and nothing makes medical promises.

Execution

  • Local search and Google Business Profile optimisation
  • Treatment pages written with the clinic's clinical team
  • Search campaigns for high-intent local searches
  • Landing pages with appointment request forms and click-to-call
  • Enquiry log and response-time standards
  • Appointment reminder workflow with consent

Tools and platforms

  • Google Search Console
  • Google Ads
  • Google Business Profile
  • Google Analytics 4
  • A simple CRM or shared enquiry log

Results

No results are claimed. This is a demonstration, so there is no real performance data. In a real case study this section reports verified figures supplied by the client. We would report measures such as:

  • Appointment requests by source
  • Calls and WhatsApp clicks
  • Response time to new enquiries
  • Booked versus requested appointments
  • Local search visibility

Services involved

  • SEO
  • Google Ads / PPC
  • Lead Generation
  • Marketing Automation
